verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a free, fully featured Sandbox. It supports all Plaid API and Link functionality and allows unlimited test Items (plaid-docs-7, plaid-docs-13). A Sandbox-only /sandbox/public_token/create endpoint creates Items for an arbitrary institution ID with chosen products and test credentials (plaid-docs-14), and the Quickstart app supports local end-to-end testing (plaid-docs-10). Together these cover linking and data retrieval before going live. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to trigger error states in Sandbox, the actual test institution list and credential values, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
